Assumptions and data handling

  • No figures were typed manually into the report tables. The dashboard embeds the GL CSV rows and computes totals in JavaScript from Debit and Credit columns.
  • Net expenditure = Debit − Credit. Negative amounts are retained and displayed because they represent credits, reversals, or corrections in the ledger.
  • Fiscal year mapping: CMI FY2026 is treated as October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026. Quarter mapping is Q1 Oct-Dec, Q2 Jan-Mar, Q3 Apr-Jun, Q4 Jul-Sep.
  • Department and fund names: Department titles come from the CSV. Fund descriptions are not invented because the CSV provides fund codes only.
  • Full-ledger inclusion: The embedded data contains all 22,804 CSV rows and the original columns: TransSource, SessionID, Fund, GL, GL Title, Function, Department, Department Title, Program, PostTo, TransDesc, DocNum, Name, Debit, Credit, Type.
